titration.title: Acid-Base Titration
titration.subtitle: Determine concentration of HCl using NaOH
titration.overshot.hint: Real titrations require slow, drop-by-drop addition near the endpoint. Try again!
titration.step1.title: Prepare the Burette
titration.step1.desc: Click 'Fill Burette' to fill it with 0.1M NaOH solution up to the 0 mL mark.
titration.step1.hint: In a real lab, you would rinse the burette 3 times with NaOH before filling.
titration.step2.title: Add HCl to Flask
titration.step2.desc: Click 'Add HCl' to pipette 25 mL of 0.1M HCl into the conical flask.
titration.step2.hint: Use a pipette for accurate volume measurement — not a measuring cylinder.
titration.step3.title: Add the Indicator
titration.step3.desc: Click the phenolphthalein bottle to add 2-3 drops to the flask.
titration.step3.hint: Phenolphthalein is colorless in acid and pink in base. This tells us when we've reached the endpoint.
titration.step4.title: Perform the Titration
titration.step4.desc: Open the stopcock and add NaOH slowly. Watch the pH and color change. Close the stopcock when the flask turns permanently pink.
titration.step4.hint: Near the endpoint, add NaOH one drop at a time. The permanent pink color should last 30 seconds.
